title: Learning Concepts, Not Tokens: Self-Supervised Semantic Alignment for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.29123v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The next-token prediction (NTP) objective trains language models to predict a single token at each step, even though many continuations can express the same meaning. For example, in the sentence ``this sticker can be placed here'', positioned, attached, or put are all plausible alternatives. While standard NTP training treats these alternatives as mutually exclusive targets, we explore a self-supervised framework that encourages models to predict concepts, approximated as sets of semantically equivalent tokens. Models trained with this concept supervision align better with human similarity judgments, improve classification, clustering, and reranking performance, and achieve comparable or stronger downstream reasoning. These gains come with lower perplexity on semantically meaningful words (Section 3.2) and only minimal increases in global perplexity, suggesting that concepts enhance semantic alignment while preserving language modeli

translated_title: 学习概念而非词元：语言模型的自监督语义对齐
translated_abstract: 下一词预测（NTP）目标训练语言模型在每一步预测单个词元，尽管许多不同的续写都可以表达相同的含义。例如，在句子“这个贴纸可以放在这里”中，“贴上”、“安放”或“放置”都是合理的替代词。标准的NTP训练将这些替代词视为互斥的目标，而我们探索了一种自监督框架，鼓励模型预测概念，即用语义等价词元的集合来近似表示概念。使用这种概念监督训练的模型与人类相似性判断更好地对齐，提升了分类、聚类和重排序性能，并实现了相当或更强的下游推理能力。这些收益伴随着在语义上有意义的词上更低的困惑度（第3.2节），而全局困惑度仅有极微小的增加，表明概念学习在保持语言建模能力的同时增强了语义对齐。
tldr: 该论文提出一种自监督框架，让语言模型预测由语义等价词元集合近似的概念而非单个词元，从而更好地对齐人类相似性判断，提升分类、聚类、重排序和下游推理性能，且全局困惑度仅增加极少。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised framework that trains language models to predict concepts, approximated as sets of semantically equivalent tokens, rather than single tokens, achieving better alignment with human similarity judgments and improved classification, clustering, reranking, and downstream reasoning, with only minimal increases in global perplexity.
